Warning, consumption may cause spontaneous toe combustion, green diarrhea, and an inexplicable desire to vote libertarian. Cluckin Bell, taste the misery. Tired of your wife screaming about the mortgage. Hide your cash with Fleeca Bank. We offer zero percent interest and one hundred percent protection from federal indictments, provided you slip the branch manager a crisp fifty. Fleeca, your money is safer with us than in your underwear drawer. Disclaimer, we are not FDIC insured and if the CEO skips town to Cabo, your savings are now a yacht.

Need a weapon that screams I peaked in high school. Ammu Nation has you covered. Buy one tactical flamethrower, get a box of hollow points and a tear-stained diary absolutely free. Perfect for stopping home invaders, annoying neighbors, or that guy who cut you off on Del Perro Freeway. Ammu Nation, keep America heavily medicated. Disclaimer, all firearms come pre-loaded with a tracking device straight to the nearest FBI field office.

Hey Los Santos. Chad here. I used to be a beta male who cried during Pixar movies. Then I started drinking Sprunk. Now I can punch through concrete walls and I haven't blinked in four days. Sprunk, the taste of pure liquid ADHD. Disclaimer, may contain industrial solvent, battery acid, and traces of lead paint. Drink responsibly or your kidneys will violently explode.
